newsitem.title: USA: Petroleum sees FY 1997 EPS below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Petroleum sees FY 1997 EPS below estimates.

text.p: Petroleum Helicopters Inc said on Wednesday that it anticipates net income for the fiscal year that ended April 30 to be "well below" analysts' current estimates.

The company said in a news release than an expansion of its helicopter fleet led to higher-than-expected maintenance costs during the fourth quarter. It expects net earnings for fiscal 1997 to approximate the level achieved the previous year. Final results will be released in mid-June.
The company said the fleet expansion will be good for the company over the long term if a recent increase in the demand for helicopter services continues.
The First Call consensus estimate for Petroleum Helicopters' fiscal-year 1997 earnings is $1.56 per share. For the fourth quarter, the consensus estimate is $0.37 per share.
